Yamaha DS-1 / DS-1E microcode

Copyright (c) 1997-1999 Yamaha Corporation. All Rights Reserved.

Origin: alsa-project/alsa-firmware, tag v1.2.4, ymfpci/hwmcode.c
https://github.com/alsa-project/alsa-firmware/blob/v1.2.4/ymfpci/hwmcode.c
Upstream Git blob: 499a6669748fedbcf8c3995a7017424381eb6d9b

Imported file: third_party/yamaha/ds1_microcode.h. The original notice is
retained verbatim in that file. CiukiOS changed unsigned long arrays to
const uint32_t arrays; no instruction value changed. UPSTREAM.json records
the imported file hash and the size/SHA-256 of each little-endian firmware
image. The header is compiled into the kernel; no external firmware loader
or separate disk payload is required.

The Yamaha file supplies no explicit redistribution grant. Its notice is
not the donor driver's GPL licence. Import is directed by the owner's
2026-10-22 23:55 licence decision, recorded in
docs/design/peripheral-driver-coverage.md; that decision does not change
Yamaha's copyright or create a new licence grant.

Yamaha DS-XG PCM driver adaptation

Copyright (c) by Jaroslav Kysela <perex@perex.cz>
SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

Origins (Linux v6.12):
sound/pci/ymfpci/ymfpci.c (ID table)
  Git blob 48444dda44defdad3ee3b30bd3ba40d3555111c1
sound/pci/ymfpci/ymfpci.h (registers, bank layout)
  Git blob a408785cfa1ba451df5d806fb3dcd478bf5f5fe4
sound/pci/ymfpci/ymfpci_main.c (firmware, bank, codec and PCM algorithms)
  Git blob 6b8d8690b6b204eee0cad44e74c7c5afd380d230
https://github.com/torvalds/linux/tree/v6.12/sound/pci/ymfpci

Adapted file: src/kernel/drivers/ymfpci.c. CiukiOS replaces Linux/ALSA
services with its existing ownership, MMIO, pinned DMA, clock, mixer and
IRQ interfaces; adds firmware hashes/readback, elapsed deadlines, coherent
bank observations, stop proof and permanent quarantine. No ALSA framework
is imported. The GPL version 2 text is retained at the repository LICENSE.
